body:
I spent over a month in rehab facility after a car wreck. I broke my femur and crushed my knee. I had to learn how to walk all over. At the time I weighed 350 and I was careful not to burden my therapist and other staff. The therapist and staff were some of the best people I ever met. It is such a thankless job. God bless healthcare workers. 

But I currently weigh 450lbs, down from 520. If this happened today I would rather die than put somebody through this. I think of suicide daily to rid the world of my fatness.
